summary: Validate approved single-package label requests, safely decode one PDF label, and persist only typed shipment receipts and private label paths.
reason: The generated command previously treated successful Ship API responses as opaque JSON and could not guarantee one bounded PDF label, durable tracking state, or redacted mutation output.
validated_outcome: Tests cover required shipment fields, one-piece and one-grouped-package PDF-only policy, response variants, missing/malformed/oversized labels, private atomic label writes, typed shipment ledger entries, safe mutation receipts, and replay rejection.
